architecture: current relative target state -> nominal velocity guidance -> CBF/QP safety filter (identity, Prompt 1) -> quadrotor velocity executor

control_mode_switch.location: SoldierEnv.__init__ constructor argument (deliberately NOT an EnvConfig field, so it can never perturb dataclasses.asdict(config) used by every prior curriculum stage's frozen protocol/handoff hashes)

environment.defender: structurally present, cannot terminate the episode (intercept_radius=1e-6, the established no-defender-interaction curriculum mechanism, reused unchanged)

executor.model: acceleration-limited (no heading/turn-rate limit) 3-D quadrotor point mass
executor.swept_mission_contact: unchanged single linear segment over the full 0.5s external step; no new/parallel contact test

freeze_rule: kp, speed/accel/climb/descent limits, substep, capture radius are frozen BEFORE the acceptance run and never tuned afterward
hypothesis: An analytical, literature-motivated relative-target pursuit law combined with an acceleration-limited quadrotor velocity executor (no legacy heading/turn-rate limit) fixes the repeated-fly-by failure mode observed throughout the PPO/BC A1 curriculum (Stages 4, 4A, 4A-1) under the existing canonical moving-asset benchmark, with no RL training.

nominal_guidance.law: v_nom = min(max_speed, kp * ||r||) * r_hat, r = asset_pos - attacker_pos (CURRENT, never initial/predicted)

safety_filter.future_stage: CBF/QP obstacle + defender avoidance (NOT implemented here)

scope: pursuit + dynamics foundation ONLY; no obstacle CBF, no defender CBF, no RL training -- research focus beyond this stage is the counter-UAS defender
